about: Northern Lights is a family-owned and operated adult-use cannabis retailer serving communities across New York. We’re committed to creating a welcoming, professional environment where adults 21 and over can explore carefully selected cannabis products with confidence.

Our approach is simple: offer fair pricing, reliable service, and a thoughtful customer experience. We proudly match any local price to ensure our customers receive consistent value, and we provide convenient delivery options to meet you wherever you are.
At Northern Lights, we focus on quality, transparency, and community—helping you make informed choices in a space built on trust and respect.

whitehall: Northern Lights Whitehall is a family-owned dispensary on Broadway in Whitehall, NY
in a bright red clapboard building
the only licensed dispensary in town
feels like a jam-band living room in a village general store, lit by the northern lights
inside, a Jerry Garcia portrait looks over a guitar on its stand, a Persian rug, a leather armchair, live-edge wood and houseplants
the friendly, quick-witted staff remember regulars by name and help newcomers find their way
the store sits at the south tip of Lake Champlain, a short drive from Vermont
its night-sky aurora badge, music and pop-up nights, seasonal humor, price match, same-day delivery and the pizza place downstairs make it a neighborhood hangout
a no-attitude, LGBTQ+-friendly place where locals, lake-goers and Vermont neighbors stop in, take a seat and leave with exactly what they came for
brief.menands: its sister store in Menands, just off I-787 near Albany, carries the same family-run spirit into the city
confirm: 'the only licensed dispensary in town' (operator brief; re-check against the OCM dispensary map before launch)

items.name: Breanna
items.text: I come here often and usually do a pick up order that’s ready right away. Dejon usually assists me and he is very personable and knows his stuff! It’s clean and overall a nice atmosphere if you’re stopping in or hanging around when there is entertainment! Thankyou so much.

items.name: Christopher
items.text: The customer service you receive at Northern lights dispensary is way above and beyond. Now eligible friendly employees. The prices are amazing. They have deals and specials and bargains you would not even believe. Just an amazing experience overall. I couldn’t be more satisfied Just very very good.

items.name: Eric
items.text: I’ve been here a few times now, and I love the wide variety of selection offered at this store. Everything is very reasonably priced and the staff is helpful and accessible. All products that I have bought from here have been spectacular. Highly recommend visiting if you’re in the Albany-suburbs area. Thanks, NL!

items.name: Fern
items.text: Solid spot with a chill vibe. Clean layout, friendly staff, and an easy shopping experience. Definitely somewhere I’d return to. In addition, they’re a minority and veteran owned brand, would be a great move.

items.name: Kody
items.text: Leading dispensary on their turf by far. The bud tenders are super knowledgeable, and they always have the right thing for what I’m feeling. The best part- it’s a comfortable, welcoming shopping environment. Highly recommend their Grassroots Diamond Flower and Select 2g vape!

items.name: Tanya
items.text: This is by far the best dispensary in this area. Not only do they have knowledge of what is best for each customer, they truly help. Anyone can open a business — not everyone can provide the type of customer service this company has acquired. I come from an upper management retail and medical (pharmacy) background and typically do not leave Google reviews, but this company has pulled out all the stops… This will be my sole dispensary going forward. If you want great service with reasonable prices, this is the dispensary for you. They’ve helped me, my sister, and at least 10 other friends. They are fantastic.

store_attribution.note: the posts do not say which store each review is for; Eric's mentions the Albany suburbs (likely Menands); not asserted
